status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 160% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 160 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Somalia has expelled the United Arab Emirates ambassador after accusing Abu Dhabi of converting civilian airfields in Somaliland and Puntland into military bases and funding armed groups that undermine national unity. Federal forces quietly relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy, while U.S. airstrikes hit al-Shabaab at three locations across the country. The United States reversed its stance, now funding UN military support in Somalia for another year after previously withdrawing that funding. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
